title: Pathogenic Mechanisms of Port Wine Stain and Repository of Port Wine Stain Biopsy Samples
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the pathogenic mechanisms of Port Wine Stain, collect biopsy samples and blood samples to characterize exosomes and metabolites from Port Wine Stain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female of all ages.
* Not pregnant.
* Has diagnosis of port wine stain on the arms, legs, chest, bac.
* Ability to understand and carry out subject instructions.
* Subject willing to have skin biopsies on port wine stain and normal skin areas.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women.
* Port Wine Stain on the face.
* History of skin cancer.
* Current participation in an investigational drug evaluation
* Concurrent use of known photosensitizing drugs.
